business_summary: Melco Resorts & Entertainment Limited develops, owns, and operates casino gaming and resort facilities in Macau, the Philippines, Cyprus, and internationally. It operates through City of Dreams, Studio City, Altira Macau, Mocha, City of Dreams Manila, City of Dreams Mediterranean and Other, Other Operations, and Corporate and Other segments. The company owns and operates City of Dreams, an integrated resort that has gaming tables and gaming machines; suites and villas; food and beverage outlets; retail outlets; a wet stage performance theater; and recreation and leisure facilities, including health and fitness clubs, swimming pools, spas and salons, and banquet and meeting facilities in Cotai, Macau. It also operates Studio City, a cinematically themed integrated resort with gaming facilities, hotel, entertainment, retail, and food and beverage outlets in Cotai, Macau; and Altira Macau, an integrated resort, which offers gaming tables and gaming machines, hotel rooms, dining and casual restaurants, and recreation and leisure facilities in Taipa, Macau. In addition, the company owns and operates Mocha Clubs, which are clubs with gaming machines in Macau; City of Dreams Manila, an integrated resort in the Entertainment City complex in Manila; City of Dreams Mediterranean, an integrated resort in Limassol, Cyprus; and three satellite casinos in Nicosia, Ayia Napa, and Paphos in Cyprus. Further, it is involved in the operation of the Sri Lanka Casino and management of Nüwa Sri Lanka located in City of Dreams Sri Lanka, as well as development projects in other countries. The company was formerly known as Melco Crown Entertainment Limited and changed its name to Melco Resorts & Entertainment Limited in April 2017. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Central, Hong Kong. Melco Resorts & Entertainment Limited is a subsidiary of Melco Leisure and Entertainment Group Limited.
business_summary_ko: Melco Resorts & Entertainment Limited는 마카오, 필리핀, 키프로스 및 해외에서 카지노 게임 및 리조트 시설을 개발, 소유 및 운영합니다. City of Dreams, Studio City, Altira Macau, Mocha, City of Dreams Manila, City of Dreams Mediterranean 및 기타, 기타 운영, 기업 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 게임 테이블과 게임 기계를 갖춘 통합 리조트인 City of Dreams를 소유하고 운영합니다. 스위트룸과 빌라; 음식 및 음료 판매점; 소매점; 습식 무대 공연 극장; 마카오 코타이에는 헬스 및 피트니스 클럽, 수영장, 스파, 살롱, 연회 및 회의 시설을 포함한 레크리에이션 및 레저 시설이 있습니다. 또한 마카오 코타이에서 게임 시설, 호텔, 엔터테인먼트, 소매점, 식음료 매장을 갖춘 영화 테마의 통합 리조트인 Studio City를 운영하고 있습니다. 마카오 타이파에 게임 테이블과 게임 머신, 호텔 객실, 다이닝 및 캐주얼 레스토랑, 레크리에이션 및 레저 시설을 제공하는 통합 리조트인 알티라 마카오(Altira Macau)가 있습니다. 또한 회사는 마카오에서 게임기를 갖춘 클럽인 Mocha Clubs를 소유 및 운영하고 있습니다. 시티 오브 드림스 마닐라(City of Dreams Manila)
